title: Ingot capture set, version 1
description: A coherent group of captured UI components. This is the only input the distillation engine accepts. Prose documentation: docs/capture-record.md

id.description: Slug. Must match the fixture directory name; becomes the examples/ output directory name.
Stable, unique within the set. Provenance addresses captures by this id, so it must survive a recapture of the same element.

componentType.description: Coarse tag used to weight style observations. Not a component model.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant. Recorded for the operator; never read by the engine, so it cannot affect output.

screenshot.description: Reserved for a future screenshot reference. Must be null. The engine never reads pixels.

notes.description: Free-text human note. Never read by the engine.

capturedStyles.description: Computed style values. Keys mirror CSSOM camelCase property names; values mirror what getComputedStyle returns: resolved strings, never var() references or relative units. Every property is optional; a capture carries only what was relevant to the element.

lineHeight.description: An absolute px length, a unitless ratio, or "normal". "normal" is ignored: its resolved value depends on the font.

boxShadow.description: "none", or one or more comma-separated CSS shadow layers. inset shadows are parsed but excluded from the elevation scale.

cssColor.description: Any CSS colour syntax culori can parse: #rrggbb, rgb()/rgba(), hsl(), oklch(), named colours. Fully transparent values are read as "no colour" and contribute nothing.

cssLength.description: Absolute px length. Computed styles always resolve to px, so no other unit is accepted.
